definitions.explanation: A supplementary discussion or narrative that comes after the main content. Used for the closing section of a book, broadcast, performance, or event where the author or host offers reflections, commentary, or behind-the-scenes talk.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あとがたり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧。
examples.english: The afterword of this book is interesting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧あとがたり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a post-show talk event after the stage performance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上映後|じょうえいご}、⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧あとがたり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{制作|せいさく}→制作：04320_seisaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{裏話|うらばなし}→裏話：14031_urabanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: After the film screening, there was a post-film talk by the director, where we could hear behind-the-scenes stories about the production.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧ (after) and ⟦{語|かた}り→語る：01930_kataru⟧ (narrative; talk). Written in hiragana as あとがたり or sometimes in kanji as {後語|あとがた}り. The word covers a range of post-content commentary formats — from written afterwords in books to live discussion events after performances.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- あとがたり⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧: post-show/post-screening talk event
- あとがたり⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧: afterword segment (in a broadcast)
- ⟦{著者|ちょしゃ}→著者：03501_chosha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あとがたり: author's afterword

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦あとがき→あとがき：21507_atogaki⟧: afterword/postscript — the standard term for written afterwords in books; more common in publishing
- エピローグ: epilogue — the concluding section of a literary or dramatic work
- ⟦{打|う}ち{上|あ}げ→打ち上げる：06732_uchiageru⟧: wrap-up party — a social gathering after an event (different nuance: celebration, not discussion)
